title: Flat module and flat ring map
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. An $R$-module $M$ is *flat* if for every injective $R$-linear map $N_1\to N_2$ of $R$-modules the induced map $N_1\otimes_RM\to N_2\otimes_RM$ is injective. A ring map $\varphi:R\to S$ of commutative rings is *flat* if $S$, an $R$-module via $\varphi$, is a flat $R$-module.
